edges.relationship: Bitquery labels each drained wallet as a Binance PoR address; five XRPL source wallets are included in the provider's labeled set.
TRM assessment reported by Reuters says compromised signing infrastructure authorized withdrawal instructions; the five XRPL payments carry valid Binance wallet signatures.
Approximately 233.5M XRP remained at the receiver at the 06:43 UTC Bitquery cutoff; no outgoing transaction was observed by that cutoff.
Binance reported more than USD 6.34B in company resources, including USD 5B in impacted token assets, and USD 3B frozen/protected.
CoinDesk identifies Binance 14 in the October 1 reserve snapshot; this supports an ETH/USDT PoR reconciliation but does not identify the five XRPL wallets.
Binance's published method states monthly snapshots occur on the first and results by the seventh; November data are the next public reconciliation checkpoint.

hypothesis_additions.claim: The five XRPL sending accounts were part of Binance's proof-of-reserves wallet universe.
hypothesis_additions.disconfirming_evidence: Bitquery's provider labels are not a direct official Binance address-file match; CoinDesk's published crosswalk in the reviewed article concerns Binance 14 on Ethereum.

hypothesis_additions.claim: The attacker gained the ability to induce Binance's transaction-signing infrastructure to authorize withdrawals across chains.
hypothesis_additions.disconfirming_evidence: Binance has not published the complete postmortem or exact authorization path; no wallet private-key leakage has been established.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Binance's announced USD 6.34B in company resources may restore affected customer balances and replace stolen tokens.
hypothesis_additions.disconfirming_evidence: The aggregate company statement does not disclose XRP-specific purchases, wallet replenishment, current reserve ratio or completed customer-level reconciliation.

hypothesis_additions.claim: The 233.5M XRP held by the attacker may become future sell-side supply if moved into liquid venues.
hypothesis_additions.disconfirming_evidence: No sale or exchange deposit was identified by Bitquery's 06:43 UTC cutoff; later disposition is unknown and Binance has committed to cover customer losses.
